$comment: Generated by gh-settings 0.1.0. Do not edit by hand; run `gh settings schema`.

is_alphanumeric.description:
Whether the reference is alphanumeric rather than purely numeric.

Defaults to `true`, matching GitHub. Set to `false` for systems whose
identifiers are always numbers.

key_prefix.description:
The prefix that triggers the link, for example `OPS-`.

This is the autolink's identity: changing it creates a new autolink rather
than modifying the existing one.

url_template.description:
Target URL, containing the `<num>` placeholder.

For example `https://jira.company.com/browse/<num>`.

BypassActor.description:
Who may bypass a ruleset.

Declared by slug rather than id: numeric ids are neither stable across
organisations nor meaningful to a human reading the file, which would make an
exported configuration unusable anywhere but its origin. Resolution happens in
[`Resource::prepare`](crate::resources::Resource::prepare).

actor_id.description:
Raw actor identifier.

An escape hatch for actor kinds this build does not model by name, such as
repository roles, whose identifiers vary between organisations and so
cannot be safely mapped from a name.

actor_type.description: Raw actor type, used together with `actor_id`.

app.description: Bypass through a GitHub App, by slug.

team.description: Bypass through an organisation team, by slug.

BypassMode.description: When a bypass actor may bypass the ruleset.

Conditions.description: Which refs a ruleset applies to.

Enforcement.description: How strictly a ruleset is applied.

oneOf.description: Evaluated and reported, but not enforced. Requires GitHub Enterprise.

color.description:
Six hexadecimal digits, with or without a leading `#`.

Normalised to lowercase without the `#`, which is how GitHub stores it.

description.description: Optional short description, at most 100 characters.

name.description:
Label name.

When `new_name` is set, this is the name the label currently has.

new_name.description:
Rename this label to the given name.

Renaming preserves the label's assignments, which deleting and recreating
would not.

anyOf.description: Bare list form. Additive: unmanaged items are left alone.
Object form, able to enable pruning.

items.description:
The declared items.

Modelled as an `Option` rather than a defaulted `Vec` so the section
does not require its item type to implement `Default`.

prune.description:
Delete items that exist on GitHub but are absent here.

Defaults to `false`. Overridden by `--prune` / `--no-prune`.

Prunable.description: A collection section that can opt into pruning.

include.description:
Patterns to include.

Supports the special values `~DEFAULT_BRANCH` and `~ALL`.

allow_auto_merge.description: Whether auto-merge is available on pull requests.

allow_update_branch.description: Whether updating a pull request branch is allowed.

anonymous_access_enabled.description: Whether anonymous Git read access is enabled (GitHub Enterprise only).

archived.description:
Whether the repository is archived.

Archiving is effectively one-way through the API: GitHub allows setting
this to `true`, but unarchiving must be done in the web UI.

default_branch.description:
The default branch.

Renames the branch; it must already exist.

delete_branch_on_merge.description: Whether head branches are deleted automatically after merge.

description.description:
Short description shown under the repository name.

Set to `null` to clear it.

has_discussions.description: Whether the discussions tab is enabled.

has_issues.description: Whether the issue tracker is enabled.

homepage.description:
Project website shown next to the description.

Set to `null` to clear it.

is_template.description: Whether the repository is a template.

merge_commit_message.description: Default commit message for merge commits.

merge_commit_title.description: Default commit title for merge commits.

private.description:
Whether the repository is private.

Changing this is possible but consequential — it can delete forks and
break published links — so `plan` always flags it.

squash_merge_commit_message.description: Default commit message for squash merges.

squash_merge_commit_title.description: Default commit title for squash merges.

topics.description:
Topics.

Accepted here only for `safe-settings` compatibility; prefer the
top-level `topics` section.

Rule.description:
A single rule within a ruleset.

Modelled as `{ type, parameters }` rather than a closed enum of every known
rule so that a rule type this build predates round-trips untouched instead of
being silently dropped.

type.description: The rule type, for example `pull_request` or `required_status_checks`.

name.description:
Ruleset name.

This is the identity used for matching. Server ids never appear in the
configuration because they are not portable between repositories.

SecuritySettings.description:
Security and analysis features.

The API models these as `{ status: "enabled" | "disabled" }` objects rather
than booleans; the configuration exposes plain booleans and the resource
translates.

oneOf.description: The commit messages of the branch.
The commit title, when the pull request has a single commit.
Pushes, including to repositories without branches yet.

description: Declarative GitHub repository settings, managed by the `gh settings` CLI extension.

repository.description:
Repository metadata: description, homepage, features, merge and security
settings.

topics.description:
Repository topics.

Also accepted under `repository.topics` for `safe-settings`
compatibility; declaring both is an error.

version.description: Schema major version this file targets.
